results.title: HOMESTRETCH: Surfing legends make history in Siargao
results.content: From a little-known island to a global stage, Cloud 9’s world-class waves capture the charm of Filipino culture and talent

results.title: Pedro Taduran retains world crown by clear unanimous decision
results.content: Pedro Taduran, the pride of Libon, Albay, still stands as the Philippines' sole world boxing champion after a decisive win over Brandon Moreno of Spain
